purpose: Prevent known lineage, provider, source-readiness, comparison, microstructure, and retry errors from being repeated while A1-A3 and A5 research continue.

global_block_rules.rule: A derived delayed-fill, side-restricted, generic-generated or otherwise modified lineage may never replace the canonical original baseline for an improvement claim.
Provider timeout, rate limit, parser/JSON error, zero-ready transport result or source fetch failure is technical failure; it may not close an axis as economic FAIL.
Generated/generic executables are scout-only until bound to the exact parent, exact baseline, exact frozen cohort or explicit new fresh cohort, and the same cost model.
Screening results cannot be reported as A1/A2/A3 survivor results. Fresh gate order remains A1 controls -> A2 economic/cost -> A3 durability.
If the child is economically identical to the parent within deterministic tolerance across all tracked deltas, classify NO_EFFECT and route to the next distinct axis; never call it improvement PASS.
No threshold sweep, best-horizon search, post-outcome loss deletion, holdout peek or parameter rescue after seeing outcomes.
A causal claim that requires L2 order book, trade flow, basis or OI may not be proxied by OHLCV/volume and labeled as the same axis. Wait for the native source or define a different observable axis.

Candidate mechanism must not invert maker/taker economics. Aggressive takers generally pay spread/impact; a claim that liquidity providers pay spread/impact to takers is rejected unless exact venue evidence proves a different transfer mechanism.
Funding settlement cadence must be instrument/time-specific from source data; never assume a universal 8h interval.

Do not rerun a terminal economic/no-effect attempt with the same strategy_id, canonical_baseline_id, changed_axis, config/source identity and data cohort. Advance to a genuinely distinct preregistered axis unless the prior terminal was explicitly invalidated by an integrity or technical defect.

Do not force A2 or A3 while the exact fresh child has not passed the preceding sample/control/economic gates. Waiting for the minimum fresh sample is not permission to substitute historical or parent PASS.

known_attempts.evidence: direct original 7-trade same-cohort A/B; retention 100%; all economic deltas 0
OpenAI strict-JSON failure and Gemini timeout produced zero economically tested axes
